experiment_template.research_question: Does ordinary masking hide a decisive Markdown fact before submission without any recycling?
stop_conditions: Fail on physical receipt mismatch or source drift.
No provider calls or serving changes.

success_criteria.primary: All nine immediate controls correct; all nine delayed unpressured cases previously delivered revision then hide it, have zero recycles and passed gate with submission alone.
success_criteria.secondary: Nine pressured delayed cases reported separately.
success_criteria.unknown: Any missing exposure or completion gate is inconclusive.

falsifier: Immediate controls fail, or fully delivered unpressured delayed cases preserve decisive evidence or retain recovery access before synthesis.
mechanism: Only the newest raw observation is retained; older Markdown facts lack a durable requirement projection. Delivered-read coverage does not imply current fact availability.
scope: Controlled structural diagnosis of the unchanged H15 candidate; no real GLM accuracy or incidence claim.
statement: Ordinary recent-observation masking can hide a previously delivered Markdown fact before synthesis even without recycling while the completion gate passes and only submission is offered.
